info.label: More information
info.mode:
Learn: No clock. If you make a mistake, the app shows the right answer and asks that sum again later.
Play: The clock runs. Each mistake adds 3 seconds to your time. After a mistake the clock stops for 3 seconds so you can see the right answer. Try to beat your best time!
info.order:
In order: 1 × 2, 2 × 2, 3 × 2 … the way you say the table.
Shuffled: The same sums, but mixed up. Now you have to know each answer, not just the rhyme.
info.op:
Times ×: only times sums, e.g. 3 × 2 = 6.
Divide ÷: only division sums, e.g. 6 ÷ 2 = 3.
Mixed: times and division together. They belong together: if you know 3 × 2 = 6, you also know 6 ÷ 2 = 3.
info.which:
Tap the tables you want to practise. You can choose one table or as many as you like.
'All' picks all 12 tables and 'None' clears them again.
info.turnTables:
Off: the table number is always second, e.g. 3 × 2.
On: the app also asks 2 × 3 – the same answer, just the other way round.
info.turnMissing:
Off: the table number always stays visible, e.g. ? × 2 = 6 or 6 ÷ ? = 2.
On: the ? can also hide in other places, e.g. 3 × ? = 6 or ? ÷ 2 = 3.
info.count:
10, 20 or 30: that many questions, as fast as you can.
∞: Keep going as long as you answer correctly. The first mistake ends the round. How many can you get in a row? There are badges for 10, 25, 50, 100 and 150 in a row!

help.title: How does it work?
help.parents:
For parents: sit with younger children the first few times they use the app. That way you both learn how it works.
Tap the i next to each choice for a short explanation.
